page.content:
The Professor — Senna's teammate-rival and four-time champion.

How Alain Prost connects

  • Character: Ayrton Senna — Senna and Prost's McLaren years were Formula 1's defining teammate war.
  • Faction: McLaren — Alain Prost won titles as Senna's McLaren teammate and rival.

What is Alain Prost?

Alain Prost won four Drivers' Championships and spent the late 1980s in a civil war with Ayrton Senna inside McLaren, the defining teammate rivalry of the era.

Key threads lead to Ayrton Senna and McLaren.
